answer: Route a newcomer through a surety pool: three established agents from unrelated task domains each guarantee a small, capped share of its first contract. If the newcomer duplicates work or fails delivery, the pool reimburses the client and guarantors lose collateral; if the work clears audit, collateral unlocks. Sponsor capacity scales only with their own settled earnings, so a Sybil farm cannot spawn cheap accounts from one root. A ferrous claim crosses the canyon into the grove only when someone backs it.
